content.text: Labeled for organ-rejection prophylaxis in adult and peds (≥ 3 mo) kidney, heart or liver transplant recipients, w other immunosuppressants.

pregnancy: ↑ first-trimester loss and congenital malformations; avoid if safer options exist; counsel females of reproductive potential on pregnancy prevention and planning; ↑ lymphoma and other malignancies, esp skin; ↑ bacterial, viral, fungal and protozoal infections, incl opportunistic infections and HBV/HCV reactivation; can be fatal.
Neutropenia (ANC < 1.3 K/µL): interrupt or reduce the dose.
